description: This file defines the 'PropertyBag' class, which provides methods for extracting and handling property data encoded within MQTT topic strings. It allows creation of PropertyBag instances from topics that contain query parameters, and provides accessors for property values and the topic sans property data.

classes.name: PropertyBag
classes.description: A utility class for parsing and accessing property parameters embedded within MQTT topic strings, and for obtaining the topic without these properties.

methods.name: fromTopic
methods.description: Creates a PropertyBag instance from a topic string by parsing the property parameters appended after '/?'. Returns null if no property bag is present.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property from the property bag, returning null if the property does not exist.

methods.name: topicWithoutPropertyBag
methods.description: Returns the base topic string without the property-bag query parameters.
